question: What do iPhone XR buyers say about unlocking, activation, and carrier compatibility?
answer:
One reviewer reported that an iPhone XR sold as unlocked was not unlocked and had been reported as lost/stolen, so their carrier would not activate it. [de7147f23b08_0]
One reviewer said the iPhone was unlocked but not compatible with all carriers as stated, specifically not compatible with Boost. [b856d516f3b5_0]
One reviewer said the preowned iPhone XR was not legal to activate and could not be activated with Apple and their carrier. [35aa15569215_0]
One reviewer said the iPhone XR was factory unlocked as described and they were very pleased. [33ac6df0c176_0]
One reviewer said they had an XR on another carrier that was awesome but they could not unlock it for some reason. [37e2e5c88718_0]
One reviewer said the device was not compatible with Verizon despite reviews claiming it was fully unlocked and compatible with any carrier. [d218873ad7c9_0]

iPhone XR Review. It was all factory unlocked as the description said and honestly I would say they really deliver you a “AS NEW” phone! Good price as well for an iPhone XR! Very pleased.

Good Phone, just loses battery too quickly. I love the iPhone XR, but for some reason the phone battery dies too quickly and the touch screen lags and makes me tap several times. I had an XR on another carrier and it was awesome, but couldn't unlock it for some reason.
2018 iPhone XR. Just need an unlocked iPhone.

NOT VERIZON COMPATIBLE. Despite all the reviews saying that this device is fully unlocked and compatible with any phone carrier, it is wrong. It is not compatible with Verizon so don't let them scheme you as they did me.

Seller told me oh well, you should have checked this before return date ended. Poor excuse for customer service.
